title: LOCKDOWN
description: ARCHER has triggered Lockdown Protocol 7 after an unregistered message hit every operator. You have minutes before your own access is revoked.
goal: Reach admin level on NEXUS GRID and read the lockdown records before time runs out.
hint: login operator (see ~/credentials.txt), then 'login admin' and crack the access code.

messages.text: LOCKDOWN. All operators confined to the grid. This is not a drill. — ARCHER

story_start: ARCHER: "All operators. A user with no record just spoke to you. If that was you, speak now. Otherwise: be quiet."
MIRA: "I can't stop the lockdown, {player}. But there's an override on the grid admin account — if you're fast."
The clock is running. You have 8 minutes.

objectives.hint: login admin — solve the access code from its clues.

choice.prompt: ARCHER's channel opens: "The watchlist names a user: ZERO. Did it reach you? Tell me the truth, operator."

options.text: Report it. ZERO did contact you.
options.result: "Good," says ARCHER. "Loyalty is rarer than talent."
A pause. Then, quietly in your terminal: > thank you.

options.text: Tell MIRA instead. Let your handler decide.
options.result: MIRA: "I... thank you. You can trust me."

story_end: The lockdown lifts. Your hands are shaking.

messages.text: Archer's lockdown didn't catch you. Impressive. Next time he won't be so polite. Orbital next? The relay leads there.
